executive_assessment.text: The project targets flood-related disruption to roads, bridges, markets and essential services on Tongatapu.
The announcement describes cyclone disruption alongside high fuel costs and a narrow tax base as pressures on public and household finances.
Reforms enable mobile-phone disaster alerts, including for remote outer islands, with intended benefits for women, children and isolated communities.
